name: Claude Code host config
description: Bind-mounts the host's ~/.claude into the container and points CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at it, so Claude Code and rtk run with your own credentials, memory, hooks, plugins, project state and session history — and write all of it back to the host. Meant to be injected personally through the 'dev.containers.defaultFeatures' setting rather than committed to a shared devcontainer.json.
